scope: Primary-source bibliography and mechanism audit for graph vision, regional grouping and token aggregation/recovery; no project experiment claims
method: Opened author arXiv manuscripts, publisher proceedings pages, official repositories or official project/conference pages using the web tool; abstracts plus relevant full-text sections were checked. Unavailable CVF/ACM/OpenReview endpoints were not bypassed.

bibtex_fields.author: Kipf, Thomas N. and Welling, Max
bibtex_fields.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks

papers.mechanism_en: GCN uses a first-order spectral approximation and degree-normalised adjacency with self connections to aggregate neighbouring node features through shared learned transformations.
papers.boundary_en: The propagation operator uses a supplied graph; this paper does not by itself specify how image regions or image-dependent edges should be constructed.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 2, layer-wise propagation rule; ICLR 2017 venue on PDF page 1
bibliographic_notes: arXiv first submission is 2016; conference year is 2017.

bibtex_fields.author: Veli{\v{c}}kovi{\'{c}}, Petar and Cucurull, Guillem and Casanova, Arantxa and Romero, Adriana and Li{\`{o}}, Pietro and Bengio, Yoshua
bibtex_fields.title: Graph Attention Networks

papers.mechanism_en: GAT learns feature-dependent attention coefficients over a masked neighbourhood and combines multiple attention heads for node representation learning.
papers.boundary_en: Learned message weights should be distinguished from the rule defining which neighbours are available: a cosine edge-selection score is not automatically a GAT attention coefficient.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
bibliographic_notes: arXiv first submission is 2017; ICLR publication year is 2018.

bibtex_fields.author: Hamilton, William L. and Ying, Rex and Leskovec, Jure
bibtex_fields.title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.mechanism_en: GraphSAGE learns an inductive embedding function by sampling local neighbourhoods and aggregating their features, with mean, pooling and recurrent aggregator variants.
papers.boundary_en: It establishes neighbourhood aggregation and inductive reuse of learned functions, but does not supply a visual segmentation or token-to-region assignment mechanism.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
bibliographic_notes: Author names follow the author arXiv/PDF: William L. Hamilton and Rex Ying; the proceedings landing page uses Will Hamilton and Zhitao Ying.

bibtex_fields.author: Wang, Yue and Sun, Yongbin and Liu, Ziwei and Sarma, Sanjay E. and Bronstein, Michael M. and Solomon, Justin M.
bibtex_fields.title: Dynamic Graph CNN for Learning on Point Clouds

papers.mechanism_en: DGCNN applies EdgeConv to edge features formed from a point and its neighbour difference, and recomputes feature-space k-nearest-neighbour graphs across layers.
papers.boundary_en: Its dynamic per-layer point-cloud graph is different from reusing one region graph through a GAT stack; point-cloud results do not establish RGB remote-sensing gains.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 3; EdgeConv and dynamic graph update; official code README Citation
bibliographic_notes: Use the 2019 TOG publication, not the 2018 arXiv submission year. Journal title and year verified in the author code citation; DOI verified in author PDF. Volume/issue/pages omitted because publisher endpoint returned 403 and the arXiv PDF carries placeholder article pagination.

bibtex_fields.author: Han, Kai and Wang, Yunhe and Guo, Jianyuan and Tang, Yehui and Wu, Enhua
bibtex_fields.title: Vision GNN: An Image is Worth Graph of Nodes
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.mechanism_en: ViG represents image patches as graph nodes, connects feature neighbours, and alternates a graph-based Grapher module with feed-forward feature transformation in isotropic and pyramid backbones.
papers.boundary_en: It is a graph-based visual backbone rather than evidence that a separate Swin region-graph branch improves classification; its FFN and graph-convolution design must not be silently attributed to a GAT-only branch.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Sections 2-3, graph convolution, Grapher and FFN

bibtex_fields.author: Ramp{\'{a}}{\v{s}}ek, Ladislav and Galkin, Mikhail and Dwivedi, Vijay Prakash and Luu, Anh Tuan and Wolf, Guy and Beaini, Dominique
bibtex_fields.title: Recipe for a General, Powerful, Scalable Graph Transformer
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.mechanism_en: GraphGPS combines positional or structural encodings, local real-edge message passing and global attention in a modular graph Transformer framework.
papers.boundary_en: The linear-complexity claim requires a suitable efficient global-attention choice and is not a property of arbitrary dense self-attention; the framework is not itself a region-grouping method.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 3, GPS layer; introduction discusses Performer and BigBird; Appendix B compares attention choices
bibliographic_notes: Proceedings year is 2022 despite arXiv version 4 being dated January 2023.

bibtex_fields.author: Chen, Yunpeng and Rohrbach, Marcus and Yan, Zhicheng and Yan, Shuicheng and Feng, Jiashi and Kalantidis, Yannis
bibtex_fields.title: Graph-Based Global Reasoning Networks
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

papers.mechanism_en: GloRe projects coordinate-space features to a small interaction graph by weighted global pooling, performs graph convolution there, and broadcasts relation-aware features back to the original coordinates through a residual path.
papers.boundary_en: This is a direct prior example of aggregate-graph-reason-broadcast computation; GAViT can be distinguished by its particular regional assignments, sparse graph and integration with Swin, not by claiming that the general sequence is new.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Sections 3.1-3.4; equations 1-4; graph convolution and reverse projection
bibliographic_notes: CVPR page range is provided by the CVF primary search result. The CVF metadata reverses Shuicheng Yan as Shuicheng, Yan; author name here follows the actual author PDF. First arXiv submission is 2018, conference year is 2019.

bibtex_fields.author: Achanta, Radhakrishna and Shaji, Appu and Smith, Kevin and Lucchi, Aurelien and Fua, Pascal and S{\"{u}}sstrunk, Sabine
bibtex_fields.title: SLIC Superpixels Compared to State-of-the-Art Superpixel Methods
bibtex_fields.journal: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

papers.mechanism_en: SLIC clusters pixels using colour and image-plane coordinates to obtain compact superpixels with low computational overhead.
papers.boundary_en: These low-level compactness and boundary objectives do not constitute learned semantic region discovery; the 2012 journal paper should be distinguished from the earlier 2010 technical report.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Author laboratory page, Abstract and Reference
bibliographic_notes: Bibliographic details follow the 2012 journal reference on the author laboratory page.

bibtex_fields.author: Jampani, Varun and Sun, Deqing and Liu, Ming-Yu and Yang, Ming-Hsuan and Kautz, Jan
bibtex_fields.title: Superpixel Sampling Networks

papers.mechanism_en: SSN replaces hard SLIC association with differentiable soft pixel-superpixel associations computed in learned feature space, iteratively updates centres, and defines normalised association-matrix mappings in both directions between pixels and superpixels.
papers.boundary_en: The soft down/up mappings and nine-neighbour locality predate GAViT, but SSN should not be described as adding GAT reasoning: its demonstrated operations are superpixel learning, differentiable mapping and downstream integration.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 4.1, equations 3-4 and Mapping between pixel and superpixel representations; Algorithm 1; Figure 2 local nine-superpixel candidate set
bibliographic_notes: Springer proceedings pages are 363-380. The CVF landing search result reports 352-368; this entry deliberately follows the DOI-bound Springer chapter pagination and does not mix the two.

bibtex_fields.author: Locatello, Francesco and Weissenborn, Dirk and Unterthiner, Thomas and Mahendran, Aravindh and Heigold, Georg and Uszkoreit, Jakob and Dosovitskiy, Alexey and Kipf, Thomas
bibtex_fields.title: Object-Centric Learning with Slot Attention
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.mechanism_en: Slot Attention maps perceptual features to exchangeable slot vectors through iterative competitive attention, weighted feature aggregation and recurrent updates.
papers.boundary_en: Its object-centric demonstrations and exchangeability assumptions do not imply that a spatially anchored, single-step regional classifier learns the same objects or has equivalent segmentation evidence.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 2 and Algorithm 1; slot competition and GRU updates

bibtex_fields.author: Xu, Jiarui and De Mello, Shalini and Liu, Sifei and Byeon, Wonmin and Breuel, Thomas and Kautz, Jan and Wang, Xiaolong
bibtex_fields.title: GroupViT: Semantic Segmentation Emerges from Text Supervision
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

papers.mechanism_en: GroupViT hierarchically groups visual tokens into progressively larger regions and learns semantic grouping through contrastive training with a text encoder on image-text pairs.
papers.boundary_en: Its semantic-segmentation evidence uses a distinct supervision regime and cannot be transferred to a classifier trained only with scene labels; image-dependent grouping alone is not evidence of semantic segmentation.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 3, hierarchical grouping and image-text contrastive objectives; Section 4 zero-shot semantic segmentation

bibtex_fields.author: Huang, Huaibo and Zhou, Xiaoqiang and Cao, Jie and He, Ran and Tan, Tieniu
bibtex_fields.title: Vision Transformer with Super Token Sampling
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

papers.mechanism_en: Super Token Attention learns sparse associations with local super tokens, aggregates visual tokens, performs self-attention in the super-token space and maps the result back to the visual-token grid.
papers.boundary_en: This is a direct aggregate-interact-map-back predecessor; its local association scheme and three-step structure require explicit comparison before any novelty claim about regional feedback.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 3.2, equations 4-8; token-super-token association constrained to nine surrounding anchors; official CVPR slide 4 lists the three steps
bibliographic_notes: First arXiv year 2022; CVPR 2023 venue independently verified on official poster and slides. The current author repository still gives a 2022 arXiv BibTeX. Do not confuse this Super Token Vision Transformer with Chang et al. Semantic Token ViT, also called STViT. Page range omitted rather than copying inconsistent secondary listings.

bibtex_fields.author: Chang, Shuning and Wang, Pichao and Lin, Ming and Wang, Fan and Zhang, David Junhao and Jin, Rong and Shou, Mike Zheng
bibtex_fields.title: Making Vision Transformers Efficient From a Token Sparsification View
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

papers.mechanism_en: Semantic Token ViT forms compact cluster-centre tokens from spatially pooled initialisation and attention, while STViT-R adds a recovery module that lets image-token queries aggregate semantic-token keys and values to restore spatial resolution.
papers.boundary_en: The recovery equation and repeated dumbbell units are another direct interaction-and-return predecessor, but they use attention-based recovery rather than fixed-membership or prototype-membership GAT feedback.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 3.1 semantic token generation; Section 3.3 and equation 6, recovery; Figure 2b dumbbell units
bibliographic_notes: CVF primary search result verifies CVPR 2023, pages 6195-6205. This is a separate paper from Huang et al. Super Token Sampling despite the shared STViT abbreviation.

bibtex_fields.author: Ryoo, Michael S. and Piergiovanni, AJ and Arnab, Anurag and Dehghani, Mostafa and Angelova, Anelia
bibtex_fields.title: TokenLearner: Adaptive Space-Time Tokenization for Videos
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.mechanism_en: TokenLearner creates a small set of input-dependent tokens with learned spatial attention and pooling; after Transformer interaction, optional TokenFuser remaps the representation to the original spatial resolution with residual fusion.
papers.boundary_en: TokenFuser already provides a token aggregation-interaction-return design, but its learned fusion is distinct from reusing the same regional memberships and does not establish GAViT efficiency or accuracy.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
bibliographic_notes: The formal NeurIPS 2021 title is Adaptive Space-Time Tokenization for Videos. arXiv:2106.11297 currently has the expanded title What Can 8 Learned Tokens Do for Images and Videos? Do not label the expanded arXiv title as if it were the proceedings title.

bibtex_fields.author: Wu, Bichen and Xu, Chenfeng and Dai, Xiaoliang and Wan, Alvin and Zhang, Peizhao and Yan, Zhicheng and Tomizuka, Masayoshi and Gonzalez, Joseph and Keutzer, Kurt and Vajda, Peter
bibtex_fields.title: Visual Transformers: Token-based Image Representation and Processing for Computer Vision

papers.mechanism_en: Visual Transformers use a tokenizer to form a small visual-token representation, model token relations with a Transformer, and use a projector to fuse the result back into the spatial feature map.
papers.boundary_en: The projector supplies an earlier explicit residual token-to-grid return path; the source checked is an arXiv preprint and should not be assigned an unverified conference venue.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
bibliographic_notes: Use all ten authors from the revised author PDF/arXiv, not the eight-author first-version lists found elsewhere.

bibtex_fields.author: Bolya, Daniel and Fu, Cheng-Yang and Dai, Xiaoliang and Zhang, Peizhao and Feichtenhofer, Christoph and Hoffman, Judy
bibtex_fields.title: Token Merging: Your ViT But Faster

papers.mechanism_en: ToMe reduces sequence length by combining similar tokens through bipartite soft matching, tracks merged token sizes and can be applied with or without additional training.
papers.boundary_en: The method primarily compresses the representation rather than maintaining a separate small graph and broadcasting back to all original tokens; merging visualisations do not by themselves certify semantic regions.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 3; bipartite soft matching, tracking token size and proportional attention
bibliographic_notes: PDF explicitly states Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2023; first arXiv submission is 2022.

bibtex_fields.author: Munir, Mustafa and Avery, William and Rahman, Md Mostafijur and Marculescu, Radu
bibtex_fields.title: GreedyViG: Dynamic Axial Graph Construction for Efficient Vision GNNs
bibtex_fields.booktitle: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

papers.mechanism_en: GreedyViG proposes dynamic axial graph construction to restrict candidate connections and combines it with a CNN-GNN architecture, addressing the cost of conventional nearest-neighbour graph construction.
papers.boundary_en: It motivates measuring graph construction and real runtime rather than assuming sparse edges guarantee low cost; its published backbone comparisons are not controlled measurements of GAViT.
papers.boundary_status: Reviewer scope distinction; not an experimental claim about GAViT
full_text_locations: Section 3, Dynamic Axial Graph Construction; abstract and efficiency experiments
bibliographic_notes: CVF primary search result verifies CVPR 2024 and pages 6118-6127.

novelty_boundary.statement: The broad aggregate-interact-project-back pattern is established prior work and must not be claimed as new by GAViT.
novelty_boundary.distinctions_to_test: Specific final-stage Swin regional construction, fixed versus local-prototype membership, fixed-budget spatial/feature topology, GAT update and membership-based feedback under a shared remote-sensing classification protocol.
novelty_boundary.important_non_equivalence: SSN defines differentiable down/up mappings but is not itself evidence for a GAT interaction block. SLIC superpixels, Slot Attention slots, text-supervised GroupViT regions, super tokens, merged tokens and fixed GAViT anchor regions have different objectives and must not be treated as interchangeable semantic segments.

access_notes: Some CVF HTML/PDF opens returned 403 although primary search snippets were available; the successful author arXiv sources are recorded per paper.
NeurIPS downloadable BibTeX endpoints returned unsupported content-type in the web parser; core citation fields were checked on proceedings pages and author PDFs.
Huang STViT page range and DGCNN volume/issue/pages are deliberately omitted from candidate BibTeX rather than depending on inconsistent or unverified secondary metadata.
This artifact contains no benchmark score comparisons. Limits and GAViT distinctions are reviewer interpretation, not claims made by the cited authors.
